$comment: The listening moment of the wellbeing pack (ADR-076, Yororis). Data only: what a presence is, which voice speaks for it, which ear hears the person. The words, the guards and the crisis lines are the pack's (pack.yaml); a client draws a face and plays a voice, it never calls a model.

door.note: A turn is a chat turn with an ear and a mouth, answered over SSE. The crisis guard and the scope guard run on it, non-bypassable; their replies are the pack's fixed text.

never: a phone number given by the model
a claim to be a person

piper-fr-tom-medium.licenceReview: weights used unmodified, never redistributed; a lawyer confirms before a commercial deployment

kokoro.why: a warmer voice per presence; not in the catalogue yet, so no presence names it

lipSync.why: the voice turn returns no word timings (ADR-076 section 2); a track computed from the characters would lie
